result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains an apparent duplicate listing: two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time, and fee appear back to back, which looks like a data/rendering defect rather than intentional content.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two consecutive identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards (same thumbnail, 15-25 min label, and €0.90 delivery fee), suggesting a duplicated feed item or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and de-duplicate the restaurant list, or ensure the carousel renders unique items only.
